test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

The PM has announced a very large economic relief package for the country.

options.text: A very large economic relief package for the country has been announced by the PM.
A very large economic relief package for the country was announced by the PM.
A very large economic relief package for the PM has been announced by the country.
A very large economic relief package for the country is going to be announced by the PM.

solution:
The correct answer is- 'A very large economic relief package for the country has been announced by the PM.' 

***__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **present perfect tense**.

 
 
• So the structure for conversion is

 
 
• *subject + has/have + been + verb (3rd form) + object*
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *He has packed the clothes in the cupboard. *(**active**)
 
• The clothes have been packed in the cupboard by him. *(passive)* *
 
 
 
 
 
 

Thus *option 1 *is the correct answer. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let's understand how the sentence structure changes in present tense while converting from **active **to **passive **voice:

 
 
• Simple present - *subject + is/am/are + verb (3rd form) + object*

 
 
• *​*Example: *Football is played by him.*
 
 
 
• Present continuous - *subject + is/am/are + being + verb (3rd form) + object*
 
 
• *​*Example: *The car is being driven by him.*
 
 
 
• Present perfect - *subject + has/have + been + verb (3rd form) + object*
 
 
• *​*Example: *The car has been driven by him.​​​*
